evidence: Switches native Windows builds and CI from MSVC (cl.exe) to clang-cl, updating CMake configuration, presets, and CI scripts across the build tree.
rationale: Switching native Windows compilation to clang-cl removes a major recurring maintenance burden from MSVC bugs and ICEs while drastically improving build and execution performance. Author benchmarks report block connection throughput increasing by over 50% and CI build times dropping from 20m to 12m, while closing tracking issues #31456 and #36153.
